nom: Clinique Clarifying Face Lotion Toner 1 - Very Dry to Dry

segments.dry: The large majority of reviewers describe their skin as dry to very dry, including some with flaking, eczema, or milia, and report the toner relieves flakiness and dry patches and leaves skin comfortable, usually paired with a moisturizer afterward; a minority report the opposite, increased dryness, flaking, and peeling.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive, including several managing rosacea, are split: most report the toner is gentle, does not sting, and calms redness over time, while a minority, mostly among the lowest-rated reviews, report stinging, burning, flushing, or a rosacea flare-up.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including oily T-zones paired with drier cheeks, report the toner balances oil in the T-zone without over-drying the rest of the face.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as aging or mature, including one in her sixties, report the toner leaves skin smoother and glowing without added dryness, as part of a long-standing routine.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers with aging or mature skin, including one in her sixties, report the toner leaves skin smoother and glowing as part of a long-term routine, though none describe specific effects on fine lines or firmness.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, most self-describing as dry, very dry, or flaky, report the toner relieves flaking and dry patches without added tightness, especially when followed by a moisturizer. A notable minority, concentrated among the lowest-rated reviews, report the opposite: increased dryness, flaking, and peeling, several attributing this to the alcohol/witch hazel base and comparing it unfavorably to Clinique's discontinued Mild Clarifying Lotion.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive redness are split: several report calmer, less red skin over time, including one describing dramatic improvement, while multiple reviewers, mostly among the lowest-rated reviews, report burning, flushing, stinging, or a rosacea flare-up shortly after application, which they attribute to the alcohol content.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports sun spots and age spots on her cheek visibly lightening after adding the toner to her routine, alongside pore reduction; this is not a focus of most reviews.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report fewer breakouts, cleared blackheads, and reduced whiteheads with regular use; one notes mild purging in the first days that settled to fewer breakouts than expected. No reviewer in this set reports new or worsened acne caused by the toner.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily T-zones or combination skin report the toner reduces excess oil and residue left over from cleansing without over-drying the rest of the face.

aspects.libelle: Preps skin so other products absorb better
Lifts leftover dirt and makeup after cleansing
Reasonably priced for a premium toner
Bottle pours too freely, no flow control
Feels harsher than the old Mild Clarifying Lotion

extraits.titre: NOT a replacement for Mild Clarifying Lotion!!
extraits.texte: This is a POOR replacement for the Mild Clarifying Lotion! It dries out my already very dry skin and causes my rosacea to flare up! You can smell the alcohol in it the moment you open the bottle. Why mess with a good thing?!? NRING BACK THE MILD CLARIFYING LOTION PLEASE!!!

extraits.titre: #1 stings when applied now but never did before
extraits.texte: I've been using Clarifying Lotion #1 for at least 10+ yrs now and it's never done this (see below). I always have 2 bottles on hand as backup. When I changed over to my 2nd bottle recently (2nd was bought at a later time than the first), everyday when I use it, I notice that under my eyes, on the sensitive upper cheek area, it stings when applied, burns a little and turns my skin pink and raw. It also seems to really dry out my skin (skin turns flaky and white in areas until I apply moisturizer) more than usual. I thought it might be from me using additional Clinique products for a more complete skin regimen that I've been doing recently. But none of the other Clinique products I added recently stings or does this. After reading other reviews, it seems it's likely the effects of the alcohol that others have also experienced. #1 has never done this the entire time I've used it over many years. Considered switching to 1.0 but I just don't know now. Has your ratio or list of ingredients in #1 changed recently? Can I anticipate that #1 will always do this going forward? Because if so, I can't use it anymore. I don't use anything on my face, or body, that stings, burns, or turns it red.

I have been battling with rosacea which leaves my cheeks and nose bright red, textured and very dry. I have tried everything from creams to prescriptions! I ran across this and got it, not even thinking it would help with these issues. I am getting complimented daily on my skin and how bright, smooth and moisturized it looks. This has been life changing for me and I will continue buying for years to come!

I wear glasses ansbi always get blackheads on the bridge of my nose where my glasses sit. I have tried so many things to get rid of them but they either didnt work or caused too much irritation. This toner works. They are gone and my dry, sensitive skin is still behaving.

I have combination skin that is more oily than dry but this exfoliating lotion is amazing on my face! The ingredients nourish my skin without leaving my face too dry or too oily. I have used all the other exfoliating lotions by Clinique and this one, to me, is the best.

extraits.titre: Best Toner for my aging skin!
extraits.texte: This toner smooths my skin and makes it glow without drying it out. I follow the toner with Dramatically Different Moisturizing Cream and my skin is very happy!
